rules.labels: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-semibold text-muted-foreground

entry_surfaces./: editorial desktop dashboard with left midnight-tinted sidebar, top month navigation bar, central hero balance card with hide-toggle, metric grid, 50/30/20 budget breakdown, interactive donut expense chart, and recent transaction list; bottom nav on mobile
entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth screen — left deep-midnight brand hero with Finn hamster mascot graphic, live value proposition and 50/30/20 preview; right warm clean panel with email/password form and demo-login shortcut
entry_surfaces./register: split branded auth screen — left deep-midnight brand hero with Finn hamster mascot graphic, live value proposition and 50/30/20 preview; right warm clean panel with registration form and demo-login shortcut

finn_mascot.concept: Finn, the minimalist friendly hamster finance companion. Rendered as a crisp, lovable geometric SVG avatar with warm cream (#FFF5EA), soft ear accents (#F87171), and midnight blue (#070F52) outline.
finn_mascot.floating_widget: Floating action trigger on the bottom-right (z-40) with a warm badge ring 'Ajuda do Finn' and glowing beacon dot. Clicking expands a sleek side-sheet/drawer with quick prompt chips: 'Quanto gastei este mês?', 'Em qual categoria estou gastando mais?', 'Quanto ainda posso gastar?', 'Como está minha regra 50/30/20?', 'Quais contas vencem nos próximos dias?'.
finn_mascot.empathy_states: Finn offers celebratory micro-tips when 50/30/20 is within budget, friendly encouragement if close to limit, and clear calm guidance when empty.

hero_balance_card.style: Deep midnight blue (#070F52) solid gradient surface with subtle radial glow (#1A2B99 at top right), white high-contrast Sora numbers, eye toggle (data-testid='toggle-visibility-btn') to disguise values as 'R$ ••••••••', quick stats for entries/exits/savings rate, and month selector navigation.

budget_503020_component.style: Three distinct horizontal progress tracks: Necessidades (50%), Desejos (30%), Investimentos/Metas (20%). Each has current spend vs planned allocation, live percentage pill, and dynamic status badge ('Dentro do orçamento' [green], 'Próximo do limite' [amber], 'Acima do orçamento' [rose]). Non-blocking informative guidance.

global_fab_plus.style: High-visibility primary action button (FAB on mobile, top bar + quick action menu on desktop) with modal selector for: Nova Transação (Primary), Nova Receita, Nova Despesa, Nova Transferência, Nova Conta, Nova Categoria.

grids_and_layouts.transactions_page_layout: flex flex-col gap-6 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for all text against backgrounds
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: All modal dialogs trap focus; ESC dismisses sheets and modals; Tab navigates form elements and transaction action menus
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria labels on all icon-only buttons (e.g. eye hide/show, Finn mascot trigger, delete/edit actions, month navigators)
accessibility.empty_states: Never render broken or blank tables. Display illustrated empty states with direct call-to-action buttons (e.g. 'Nenhuma transação encontrada no período. Clique abaixo para registrar.')
accessibility.testing_attributes: data-testid attributes added to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, filter toggles, card values and dialog actions

image_urls.note: FINNOS uses pure high-fidelity vector iconography (Lucide React & @icons-pack/react-simple-icons for Nubank/Inter/Itaú/Bradesco bank marks) and handcrafted SVG illustrations for Finn the hamster mascot and empty states to ensure instant zero-latency loading and offline PWA reliability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure language is Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) throughout all copy, formatters, and status chips (R$ currency, dd/MM/yyyy dates).

Primary brand color MUST strictly be #070F52. Complement it with clear slate surfaces (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF in light mode, #03071E / #0A1138 in dark mode) and emerald (#10B981) for income and rose (#F43F5E) for expenses.
Use Sora Variable for headings, big currency metrics, card totals and account names; DM Sans Variable for body text, forms and subtitles.
Implement the 50/30/20 budget calculation dynamically based on categorized transactions (Necessidades / Desejos / Metas e Investimentos).
Implement the eye visibility toggle for total balance & sensitive numbers with localStorage persistence so users can hide balances in public.
Implement Finn the Hamster assistant as a lovable floating side-panel UI with sample interactive financial prompt buttons that offer instant answers.
Include sample seed data for demo (Nubank, Banco Inter, Itaú, Carteira Dinheiro, categorized transactions, 50/30/20 distribution) and add a 'Carregar dados demo' button in Settings.

For the first delivery scope: fully build Dashboard, Transactions (CRUD, search, filters, installment support), Accounts (CRUD, computed balances), Categories (CRUD, 50/30/20 tagging), Settings (theme toggle, demo data loader, profile), and graceful 'Em breve' pages for Cartões, Orçamento, Assinaturas, Metas, and Investimentos.
Add data-testid attributes to all key buttons, inputs, tabs, and balance elements.
